Priya Patel: Quick weekly check-in for Crimson onboarding — pulling token / throughput / latency snapshot.
Priya Patel: TL;DR: tokens/day 48.2k (+22% WoW, +78% QoQ), avg tokens/session 420, top route /chat-complete.
Priya Patel: Latency p50 35ms, p95 120ms (+30ms WoW), error rate 0.9% (was 0.3% last week), spend $4.2k (+18% WoW).
CS Bot: Telemetry snapshot: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/crimson/276789 (graphs: tokens, p95, errors, spend).
Priya Patel: Observations: three ingestion spikes on 2026-03-13 02:10-02:25 UTC causing autoscale throttles; KV prefix cache hit fell from 62% -> 18% after the prompt change.
Jamal Ortiz: Noted. Any indication of prompt changes or model switch causing longer sequences?
Priya Patel: Yes — customer rolled a new system prompt that adds contextual history (avg seq length +2.3x). They also flipped to an 8-bit quant variant last month to save cost; CPU scheduling increased.
Maya Chen: Recommend: (1) enable burst autoscale for their dedicated pool, (2) bump KV cache allocation temporarily, (3) run a short enablement session on batching/prompt design.
Priya Patel: Proposed quick mitigations:
```
# temporary burst autoscale for crimson pool
redwoodctl pools update crimson-dedicated --burst-capacity 2 --scale-policy aggressive
# promote a lower-latency model variant as fallback
redwoodctl models promote crimson-v1-lowlat -> crimson-v1-reserve
```
Priya Patel: Expected outcome: reduce p95 by ~25-40ms, resolve token throttles; spend may rise slightly short-term but improves user experience.
Ops Bot: Ticket CS-7542 created (high) -> assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-7542. Telemetry attached.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll ping runtime to prioritize kernel selection and KV eviction tuning. ETA: 48h for initial patches.
Maya Chen: I'll schedule a 30m enablement call with the customer's engineering lead for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Agenda: prompt length, batching, cache hits, and quick SDK tips.
Priya Patel: Renewal-risk note: medium if p95 stays above 150ms for 7+ days. Recommend we offer a short A/B of a lower-precision hosted variant to demonstrate latency improvement.
Jamal Ortiz: Agreed — will add an automatic fallback rule to rollout config: if p95 > 150ms for 5m, route to hosted low-latency variant.
Priya Patel: Action items: Jamal -> runtime ticket follow-up & autoscale flag; Maya -> enablement invite + customer playbook; Ops Bot -> escalate if p95 > 140ms. Re-check Friday morning.
Maya Chen: :thumbsup:
Jamal Ortiz: :+1:
CS Bot: Weekly summary saved to /cs/notes/crimson/2026-03-15.md and emailed to account team.
